name: Include Header
description: Include the SAM header in the output.
explanation: Includes the SAM header in the output.

name: Count Alignments
description: Return only the number of matching alignment records.
explanation: Returns only the number of matching alignment records.

name: Minimum Mapping Quality
description: Only include alignments with a minimum mapping quality.
explanation: Includes only alignments with a minimum mapping quality of {value}.

name: Output File
description: Write the output to the specified file.
explanation: Writes the output to the file {value}.

name: Reference File
explanation: Uses {value} as the reference FASTA file.
